text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...No pain in my hoof.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, Cafe!
It's certainly gotten lively around you, hasn't it!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...My nails don't hurt.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: And yet—
(Ache)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: “—No, that's wrong. I mustn't slow down. 『■■■■■■■■■■』 is—...”

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"If only I could... use my legs more.
If only I could become... faaaster."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
MORE MORE MORE MORE MORE MORE
MORE MORE MORE MORE MORE MORE
MORE MORE MORE MORE MORE MORE.
(N O)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
—Kh!
—...Haa, haa...
Just before the goal line, Manhattan Cafe seemed to suddenly lose strength in her legs.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Why did you have to make me realize it?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Why even you...
Look at me—...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe!
Can you walk? Are you hurt?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: —...There is no pain or suffering.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
If you're worried... I'll head to the infirmary.
I can... go by myself.

I exchange a glance with <chrname>.
I should be able to make it back to her
before the Japanese representatives are announced.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Thank you,
Trainer <username>. You've been a huge help.
And to you as well, Manhattan Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...You did well to hold back. If you had pushed
any further, I would have stopped you myself.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I swore that I wouldn't give up either.
...That I wouldn't let the dreams fade
from your eyes by my own hands.
Stepping out of the VR Umalator, I take Manhattan Cafe to the nurse's office.
Throughout it all, her footing remained steady. After a full examination in the infirmary, we were told there didn't seem to be any issues.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
Could I borrow your smartphone?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I should report to Satake-san in this voice.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"I will decline the position of Japan's representative...
...and instead act as support for all of you."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
My heart was fully prepared, yet...
my body is simply too frail to endure it.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The strength my "friend" seeks...
...cannot be matched with this body.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Above all else, I found myself
wanting to live up to it.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: "To protect me, nurture me... and allow me to realize my full potential... to those feelings...!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...You all are, without a doubt, my future.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Because I've seen it firsthand.
...Your strength, and your thirst for victory.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"That's why my 'friend'...
pointed at you guys and said...
............'Come with me.'"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...So you're telling me to learn more from you all.

—Returning to the gymnasium,
I lined up next to <chrname>.

Right at that moment, upon Mei Satake's command,
the project participants began
lining up in formation.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I lead this project
to fulfill the dream of becoming the world's best.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"...Now then, I will read out the names of the Umamusume
selected as representatives. The first one is—"

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: <chrname>！

I exchange looks with <chrname>.
This year, I can challenge the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe with her once again—!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Then please tell me
today's training menu."
Ever since then, Manhattan Cafe started supporting <chrname>'s training almost like a manager.
choice_data_list: Are you sure you should be skipping your own training?
Is it really okay to skip your own training?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Yes... Because I've made up my mind.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Until these legs no longer give out.
I will stay by all of your sides.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: —As one of the comrades who supports them.
(Thump! Thump! Thump! Thump! Thump!)

The sudden haunting.
It felt almost as if it was entrusting Manhattan Cafe's growth to meâ
